defs.def: the hard central part of a fruit such as an apple, that contains the seeds （水果的）果心，核儿
the central part of an object （物体的）中心部分

ex.s: This develops your core muscles and strengthens your lower back.
ex.t: 这能锻炼你的核心肌肉，强化你的下背部。

defs.def: the most important or central part of sth 最重要的部分；核心；要点；精髓

ex.s: In tai chi, the dan tian is your qi core and qi in Chinese means life force.
ex.t: 在太极拳中，丹田是你的气之核心，而“气”在中文里意为生命力。

ex.s: Chesterton identified the core problem with moving fast and breaking things through a thought experiment.
ex.t: Chesterton通过一个思想实验指出了“快速行动、打破陈规”的核心问题。

ex.s: Then, in the 1980s, Bob Johnson created the life story model of identity, in which he proposes that, as we go through life, these core features are built in with our memories to create a personal story through which we understand our lives.
ex.t: 随后在20世纪80年代，Bob Johnson创立了身份的人生故事模型，提出随着我们走过人生，这些核心特征会与我们的记忆融为一体，构成一个我们借以理解自己人生的个人故事。

ex.t: Lancom的核心是一种世界级的有效方法，借助先进技术提升语言学习。

ex.t: 悲伤想履行她的职责，却意外导致莱莉的快乐核心记忆与乐乐一起丢失。

ex.t: 担心她，乐乐和忧忧一起努力确保她找回核心记忆。

ex.s: I will arise and go now, for always night and day I hear lake water lapping with low sounds by the shore; While I stand on the roadway, or on the pavements grey, I hear it in the deep heart’s core.
ex.t: 我将起身离去，因为无论白天黑夜，我总听到湖水轻声拍岸；当我站在马路上，或灰色的行人道上，我在内心深处听到它。

ex.t: 《欧也妮·葛朗台》是一部以贪婪和社会野心双重主题为核心的小说。
